S, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE M G UMA  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioner is absent, even when the matter was passed over twice and again called at 3:30 p.m.
The petition is of the year 2022.
It is listed for fourth time for compliance of office objections.

The order sheet dated 28.10.2024 reads as under:
"Learned counsel for the petitioner is absent.
There is no representation.
The petition is of the year 2022.
The matter is listed for third time for compliance of office objections.
Inspite of that the office objections are not complied with.
I do not find any reason to adjourn the matter.
However, to afford a final opportunity, a week's time is granted to comply with the office objections.
NC: 2026:KHC:183 HC-KAR List this matter after one week."
In-spite of that, there is no progress in the matter.
Learned HCGP has filed a memo dated 05.01.2026 stating that the petitioner had filed W.P.No.9124/2025 before this Court and the same came to be allowed vide order dated 17.04.2025.
Memo is placed on record.
